title: Attacking the two 'holds its ground' gray wolves (ash wolf at Twin Stones, gaunt wolf at Wolf Scrape) carried no standing-cost warning in the action label itself ('attack ash wolf with short sword (roll 6+ on the die)'), yet both hits cost Lys regard (-1 each) and eventually escalated to 'near leaving.' Later similar choices (e.g. burning the Gallows Glade) explicitly stated 'a hit costs standing with the Free Companies, Lys and Brother Osk' in the menu before acting. The inconsistent hinting made the early Lys losses feel like a surprise rather than an informed choice.
where: Twin Stones / Wolf Scrape - 'attack ash wolf' and 'attack gaunt wolf' entries
